meta.name: audit
meta.description: Audit an inherited engagement or implementation against its evidence. Use when taking over work or joining mid-project; distinguish verified facts from inherited claims.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接手半途的工作,分清哪些是已证实的事实、哪些只是听来的说法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手别人留下的项目或工作,需要核实哪些结论真正可信
copy.tagline_en: Sort verified facts from inherited claims when taking over someone else's work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited a project or engagement and must tell verified facts from claims

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会对照证据审查你接手的工作或实现,产出审计结果,并把已核实的事实与继承来的说法区分开。
howto.when: 当你接手别人已开展的工作、或中途加入项目时触发;由 @fde 调用时,复用其当前脱敏数据包与范围,不重启已完成的设置与提问。

say.text: 审计这份接手的实现,哪些是已核实的事实?
say.note: 对照证据区分事实与继承说法。

say.text: 我中途加入这个项目,先帮我梳理现有证据。
say.note: 从允许的上下文开始,不重问已有答案。

say.text: 列出这份交接材料里还没核实的说法。
say.note: 保留未知项,不当作已确认。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude audits an inherited engagement or implementation against its evidence, produces an audit result, and separates verified facts from inherited claims.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you take over someone else's ongoing work or join a project mid-way; when called by @fde it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Audit this inherited implementation — which parts are verified facts?
say_en.note: Separates facts from inherited claims using evidence.

say_en.text: I'm joining this project mid-way; review the existing evidence first.
say_en.note: Starts from permitted context without re-asking.

say_en.text: List the unverified claims in this handover material.
